semantics: Specific claim corrections, not wholesale invalidation or new scientific validation. Earlier prose remains preserved.

updates.claim_scope: Spectra add predictive information beyond the metadata base.
updates.current_reading: The paired spectra-versus-metadata RMSE interval includes zero. The mass-conditioned contrast is a different supported comparison; a null-test result alone does not establish the paired increment.

updates.claim_scope: Pooled lot-level blank quadratics explain the loading/offset pattern.
updates.current_reading: Use deployed calibration-line-specific blanks. Pooled-lot curvature mixes distinct lines; the Pasadena-dissolves conclusion does not survive the per-line reconstruction.

updates.claim_scope: ChemSpec EC/BC provide an independent check of the Addis calibration axes.
updates.current_reading: ChemSpec EC mirrors the FTIR EC product, while ChemSpec BC mirrors HIPS/MAC. Neither is an independent thermal EC validation target.

updates.claim_scope: The five Adama quartz samples have no FTIR/HIPS comparison.
updates.current_reading: Later work assembled five date-paired Adama quartz/PTFE comparisons, with different physical filters and two comparability flags. This updates availability, not the absence of an independent Addis thermal reference.

updates.claim_scope: Extending the composition-selected model’s IMPROVE validation to Ethiopian transfer.
updates.current_reading: The Adama diagnostic shows composition-selected models overpredict its quartz EC, with only five samples, different composition and an unconfirmed analysis-ID mapping. Neither this nor IMPROVE holdouts validates Addis EC accuracy.

updates.claim_scope: Interpreting the persistent 1617–1620 band and transfer gap in terms of charcoal-like composition.
updates.current_reading: The adjusted PMF analysis supports a regional spectral marker but not a charcoal/eucalyptus assignment. Peak position and companion-band evidence remain distinct from fuel-source identification.

updates.claim_scope: Interpreting weaker direct EC_TOT scores as a pyrolysis-correction learning limitation.
updates.current_reading: On the selected cohort the oracle/composed analysis points to EC_TOR error and target scaling; the full-pool decomposition differs. Keep cohort-specific mechanisms separate from the original descriptive target scores.
